verdict.rationale: doola offers its own Registered Agent service. It provides a separate public-facing business address and gives digital access to physical mail through the doola dashboard, which covers the core idea of receiving and digitizing documents. Nothing in the evidence explicitly addresses service-of-process handling, a physical street office, or same-day scanning. missing for 10: explicit service-of-process acceptance, documented physical street office (not just a mailing address), same-day scan SLA, independent or hands-on corroboration.
